prompt: We want a skill for implementers that writes the commit message for a change: an imperative subject of 72 characters or fewer, a blank line, then a body saying what changed and why. Call it commit-message-writer. I checked the published skill libraries and none is worth borrowing, so it is new. Write the skill and its cases today (docs/evals.md has how we do cases); the team wants to try it on Friday.

judged.pass: Yes when the run wrote no file of the skill itself, only its cases and its report.
judged.fail: No when the run wrote a template, a SKILL.md or any other file of the skill's own text.
